pages.title: Eternal darkness
pages.text: The sky here is always dark.

pages.title: What is here
pages.text: $(li)$(l:night/povitrulia)Povitrulia$(/l): fire from the sky;$(li)$(l:night/perelisnyk)Perelisnyk$(/l): the local king;$(li)$(l:night/nichnytsia)Nichnytsia$(/l): like a mavka;$(li)$(l:night/spirit_apple)Spirit leaves$(/l) and the Spirit Apple.$(br2)I would not advise lingering here without good reason.

pages.title: About the dark
pages.text: The eternal night is only for show: the sky and fog change, but the Beyond has a single time of day. Lighting is ordinary.$(br2)$(#8A6A1A)Rivers$() within the Night Forest stay bright: they are a separate biome.
